Agentically orchestrated, not just a skill list

Single requests route straight to the right skill. Multi-step requests ("audit this and then clean it up") are handed to a dedicated orchestrator conductor that sequences the chain — audit → plan → execute — end to end: it arbitrates the run-lock across the whole sequence, keeps every skill reading the same current configuration, and pauses to ask you only when a real decision is needed (a sensitive item, an ambiguous case, a Claude Code continuity choice) — never on every step by default.

Quickstart

If you only remember one thing: run /organisation-setup before anything else. Every other skill reads the configuration it produces.

1

Install the plugin

Add the marketplace (recommended, see below) or load it locally into Claude Code / Cowork.

2

Run /organisation-setup

A short interview — your use case, brands or categories, taxonomy and sensitivity preferences.

3

Run /foldero

Point it at any folder. It routes to the right skill or chains audit → plan → execute for you.

~/ install --via marketplace

  1. Claude Desktop → Settings → Plugins → Add → Add Marketplace → Add from a repository
  2. Paste https://github.com/danmackenz/foldero
  3. Toggle "Sync automatically" on
  4. Click "Sync"
  5. Install foldero from the marketplace list

See README.md for full installation details, including the manual/local install alternative.

Six guarantees, every skill

RULE_01

Never deletes

Junk goes to REVIEW-TRASH, confirmed junk to CONFIRMED-TRASH. No skill ever runs rm.

RULE_02

Never opens contents

Classification is by name, extension, and structure only — never by reading what's inside a file.

RULE_03

≥90% confidence to file

Anything less confident lands in REVIEW-SORT with a one-line reason, never guessed into place.

RULE_04

Atomic units move whole

Repos, app packages, and self-contained folders are never split or restructured internally.

RULE_05

Every move is verified

Source gone, destination present — checked after every single operation, not assumed.

RULE_06

Run-lock, always logged

Concurrent runs are blocked; every mutating pass writes a dated report to _LOGS/.

Twenty skills, four groups

One router, a read-only audit-plan-execute trio, ten standalone mutating skills, and six read-only helpers — plus the orchestration layer above.

Router & trio

4
foldero
Front-door router — routes to the right skill or chains several together.
folder-audit
Read-only audit & map. Inventories, pre-tags, flags sensitivity.
folder-plan
Designs the taxonomy, routing table, and tailored docs.
folder-execute
Scaffolds, writes docs, moves files with verified reversible mv.

Privacy and safety come from rules, not promises.

Read them before trusting this with anything you care about.

~/foldero — privacy.log
CONTENTS_NEVER_OPENED

Contents are never opened. Classification is by name, extension, structure, and — with your explicit configuration — image EXIF fields only.

NOTHING_DELETED

Nothing is deleted. Even confirmed trash goes to CONFIRMED-TRASH, never rm.

RESTRICTED_GATED

Restricted content is gated. Anything tagged restricted-domain stays put until you personally sign off, per item.

TAGS_NEVER_LEAK

Tag writes never leak sensitivity. Restricted brand names are never written into portable EXIF/IPTC metadata.

GLOBAL_STATE_EXCLUDED

Global Claude state is hard-excluded. ~/.claude/ and ~/.claude.json are touched by exactly one skill, only under a four-option per-finding gate with your explicit choice and post-action verification.
